title: GraphQL Mutations
description: Build a GraphQL API with full CRUD mutations including create, update, and delete operations.

steps.title: Create user mutation
steps.description: Add a mutation createUser(name: String!, email: String!): User that creates a new user and returns it.
hints: Define a Mutation type with createUser field
Accept name and email as required arguments
Generate a unique ID and store the user in memory

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from graphene import ObjectType, Int, String, List, Schema, Field, Mutation, Argument
from fastapi_gql import GQL

users_data = []
next_id = 1

class User(ObjectType):
    id = Int()
    name = String()
    email = String()

class CreateUser(Mutation):
    class Arguments:
        name = String(required=True)
        email = String(required=True)
    Output = User

    def mutate(self, info, name, email):
        global next_id
        user = {'id': next_id, 'name': name, 'email': email}
        users_data.append(user)
        next_id += 1
        return User(id=user['id'], name=user['name'], email=user['email'])

class Query(ObjectType):
    users = List(User)

    def resolve_users(self, info):
        return [User(**u) for u in users_data]

schema = Schema(query=Query, mutation=CreateUser)
app = FastAPI()
GQL(app, schema=schema)
